short_description: An orbital Bloomberg terminal roguelike. Build trade cartels across Sol, execute hostile takeovers of rival barons, and light the planetary Stabilisers before the Doomsday Clock strikes zero.
about_the_game: Agora Station is an orbital financial terminal simulator and space trading roguelike. Operating over a living Sol astrodynamics tactical map, you deploy vessels along high-risk shipping corridors, manipulate spot commodity markets at Earth, Mars, Ceres, and Luna, and engineer hostile takeovers of ruthless sector barons before systemic collapse extinguishes humanity's last colonies.
key_features: Orbital Bloomberg Terminal HUD: Full 1280x800 native command deck designed for controller-first mastery and Steam Deck play (targeting Verified).
Dynamic Sol Astrodynamics: Real-time planetary orbits, alignment corridors, perishable cargo decay, and pirate-infested asteroid belt transit lanes.
Hostile Takeovers & Corporate Insolvency: Squeeze rival barons, purchase controlling 501-share stakes, or deploy Golden Parachutes when filing Chapter 11.
Procedural Crisis Deck: Dynamic solar flares, supply shocks, embargoes, and antitrust audits that force on-the-fly route pivoting.
The Sol System Rescue Project: Deliver critical stabiliser components across planetary stages to beat the Doomsday Clock.

content_survey_iarc.violence: None (simulation contains corporate insolvency, economic distress, and abstract spaceship hazards without gore or graphic violence).
content_survey_iarc.gambling: None (pure deterministic commodities trading simulation, no real-money gambling or loot boxes).

steam_ai_disclosure.pre_generated_content: Card illustrations, map icons and store capsule art were generated with Google's Gemini image model from prompts and approved reference images written by the team, then cropped, sized and reviewed by the team. Game code and on-screen text were written with AI coding assistants under human review.
steam_ai_disclosure.live_generation_details: No generative AI is executed or queried at runtime during gameplay.

trailer_storyboard.title: Orbital Bloomberg Terminal HUD
trailer_storyboard.description: Camera settles on 1280x800 command deck: Doomsday Clock ticking, order book depth ladder fluctuating, GalNet news ticker scrolling live market intelligence.

trailer_storyboard.title: Sol Astrodynamics & Transit Corridors
trailer_storyboard.description: Tactical map zooms out showing planetary orbits (Earth, Luna, Mars, Ceres). A vessel departs Mars along an aligned corridor with real-time transit telemetry.

trailer_storyboard.title: Hostile Takeovers & Market Manipulation
trailer_storyboard.description: Player leverages commodity spikes, executes hostile squeeze on Ares Heavy, and accumulates controlling shares on the corporate ledger.

trailer_storyboard.title: Procedural Crises & Doomsday Tension
trailer_storyboard.description: Crisis deck interrupt triggers: solar flare disrupts belt corridors, antitrust audit freezes margin accounts, player pivots cargo to avoid insolvency.

trailer_storyboard.title: The Sol System Rescue Project
trailer_storyboard.description: Player delivers the final Stabiliser stage, lighting the beacon across Sol as the Doomsday Clock freezes. Steam logo & Wishlist call to action.
